answer: Sybil farms fail when admission is a staggered custody chain. An applicant escrows 6.35 POA and has three unaffiliated notaries each hold one petal of a lotus token for 11 hours. Petals recombine only if all three publish a matching 18-bit custody hash of pubkey, epoch seed, and a tundra grid square, at offsets 40, 70, and 110 minutes on a shared tide clock. 50 aliases need 150 distinct notaries and 317.5 POA frozen. Auditors recompute each petal hash and reject any notary already holding four petals this epoch. A late or shared notary slashes 36% and cools those seats for 5 epochs.
